nodes.label: API Contract
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for the REST surface. The browser calls Next.js /api only; Next.js Axios-forwards to Spring.

nodes.label: Browser to BFF to Spring
nodes.rationale: Browser calls same-origin /api with credentials include. Next.js Axios-forwards method, query, body, and __session. Spring has no public URL and no browser CORS.

nodes.label: BFF Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Only /api/auth, /api/game, and /api/manager are proxied. /api/internal is not browser-callable.

nodes.label: Firebase Role Matrix
nodes.rationale: No role may only POST /api/auth/session. player may call auth and game. manager may also call manager. Players are blocked from /api/manager.

nodes.label: POST /api/auth/session
nodes.rationale: Verifies a Google ID token, provisions or refreshes users, and mints an __session cookie of about 5 to 14 days. No registration and no password fields.

nodes.label: Auth Me and Logout
nodes.rationale: GET /api/auth/me hydrates AuthProvider. POST /api/auth/logout clears __session and may revoke refresh tokens.

nodes.label: Weekly Picks API
nodes.rationale: GET /api/game/main and POST /api/game/picks. Empty picks are dropped. Ranks must be unique. A locked week is 409 or 400. A player cannot write another user's picks.

nodes.label: Leaderboard API
nodes.rationale: GET /api/game/leaderboard returns standings sorted by score descending, tie-break uid ascending. Future weeks and unscored games add 0. Users with no picks appear at 0.

nodes.label: Team Schedule API
nodes.rationale: GET /api/game/team-schedule for a conference member. Away opponents are prefixed with 'at '. Unplayed games omit winLoss and scoreResult.

nodes.label: Account and Theme Picker API
nodes.rationale: GET/PUT /api/game/account updates nickName and themeId only. Password field names are 400. GET /api/game/themes returns active catalog themes in catalog order.

nodes.label: Manager CRUD API
nodes.rationale: Manager-claim REST CRUD for seasons, weeks, venues, teams, rivalries, matchups, users, and themes. Stale version is rejected. Referenced deletes are 409.

nodes.label: CFBD Import Endpoints
nodes.rationale: POST /api/manager/imports/matchups returns 202 and a job id. GET polls status. POST imports/scores refreshes scores. The worker calls CFBD, not the BFF request.

nodes.label: Internal Job Auth
nodes.rationale: Cloud Scheduler OIDC or X-Pickem-Job-Secret. Cookie-only fetch is 403 and is not forwarded. Next.js forwards without the session cookie.

nodes.label: Game-day Score Job
nodes.rationale: POST /api/internal/jobs/cfbd-scores writes scores only for completed CFBD games with unequal points. Scheduler cron is hourly Thursday through Monday 12:00-23:00 America/New_York.

nodes.label: Health Checks
nodes.rationale: GET /health on Spring is a Cloud Run probe inside GCP. Next.js GET /health does not call Spring. Neither is a BFF proxy. Owned by US-40.

nodes.label: API Error Shape
nodes.rationale: 400 validation, 401 session, 403 missing manager or browser hitting internal, 409 stale version or pick lock or referenced delete, 202 import accepted, 503 CFBD failure.
